summary: This note is a Nav2 configuration file in YAML, setting parameters for the navigation stack's servers and plugins. It covers the behavior tree navigator, the controller server with a DWB local planner and goal checkers, local and global costmaps, the NavFn grid-based planner, the simple smoother, behavior server, waypoint follower, and velocity smoother. Most nodes use simulation time and a shared robot base frame, with a robot radius of 0.175 and a maximum forward velocity of 0.26.
one_line: A Nav2 ROS 2 navigation stack YAML configuration covering behavior tree, controller, costmaps, planner, smoother and velocity settings.
key_facts: The bt_navigator uses global_frame map, robot_base_frame base_link, odom_topic odom, bt_loop_duration 10, and default_server_timeout 20.
The bt_navigator plugin_lib_names list includes nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node and nav2_spin_action_bt_node among many others.
The controller_server sets controller_frequency to 20.0 and uses the progress_checker plugin with required_movement_radius 0.5 and movement_time_allowance 10.0.
The general_goal_checker uses nav2_controller::SimpleGoalChecker with xy_goal_tolerance 0.25 and yaw_goal_tolerance 0.25.
The FollowPath controller uses dwb_core::DWBLocalPlanner with max_vel_x 0.26, max_vel_theta 1.0, and sim_time 1.7.
The DWB critics include RotateToGoal, Oscillation, BaseObstacle, GoalAlign, PathAlign, PathDist, and GoalDist.
The local_costmap uses a 3 by 3 rolling window with resolution 0.06, robot_radius 0.175, update_frequency 5.0, and global_frame odom.
The local_costmap voxel_layer sets z_resolution 0.05, z_voxels 16, and max_obstacle_height 2.0.
The global_costmap uses update_frequency 1.0, global_frame map, track_unknown_space true, and inflation_radius 0.45 with cost_scaling_factor 4.0.
The planner_server uses the nav2_navfn_planner/NavfnPlanner GridBased plugin with tolerance 0.5, use_astar false, and allow_unknown true.
The smoother_server uses nav2_smoother::SimpleSmoother with tolerance 1.0e-10, max_its 1000, and do_refinement True.
The behavior_server lists spin, backup, drive_on_heading, assisted_teleop, and wait behavior plugins with cycle_frequency 10.0.
The waypoint_follower uses nav2_waypoint_follower::WaitAtWaypoint with waypoint_pause_duration 200 and loop_rate 20.
The velocity_smoother has smoothing_frequency 20.0, feedback OPEN_LOOP, max_velocity [0.26, 0.0, 1.0], and velocity_timeout 1.0.
